milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The smoker is at spawn-relative (5, 1, 5) in the open-air kitchen. The player must navigate close enough to see it (within 16 blocks) and be facing toward it (within 60°). This models 'the player has found and is looking at the smoker'. The smoker is the only smoker-type block in the scene (furnace was removed to avoid confusion), making visual identification unambiguous.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The center melon is at spawn-relative (5, 0, -3) in the fenced farm area. The player must navigate close enough to see a melon (within 16 blocks) and be facing toward it (within 60°). This models 'the player has found and is looking at a melon in the farm'. Three melons are placed in a diagonal line; targeting the center one means the facing cone also covers the adjacent melons at (4,0,-2) and (6,0,-4).
